title: A tool task plans its tools.md row in the same task
goal: The /kb-backlog skill's plan step says that a task changing a tool's commands or flags puts the kb/_self doc rows that describe them (selfdoc.py map on its files) in its own touches and writes them in the same commit, as kb/_self/git.md already requires, instead of a later docs task; the tool changes of a sprint then land without a hand-written Self-Reviewed trailer. Answers the SP-fkyrld5h failure: nine landings of tool tasks whose docs were a later task needed a Self-Reviewed trailer to pass selfdoc stale at the sync gate.
